name: Tonari ni Kanojo no Iru Shiawase ~Curious Queen~
original_name: となりに彼女のいる幸せ ～Curious Queen～
source: Main character Haru finds himself oddly drawn to Hana, a girl who seems to find no greater joy in life than teasing him and touching his hair. Little did he know that she would not only be barging into his school life, but even his home life as well!
